provenance: Lyrics transcribed verbatim from the Suno song pages on 2026-09-30 (read-only library read): 'Ad Nauseam' and 'Ad Nauseam V2' display character-for-character identical lyric text, so this one file covers both renders.

lines: Is it real or is it fake, I can't tell anymore
A I faces selling dreams from a digital store
The ad shows a game that the game never knew
Download disappointment, yeah, they played you
Fake feed, fake feed, nothing is true
Is it human or a render talking to you
sections.name: Hook

lines: Pull the pin, save the guy, that's the ad on my screen
Download it and it's match-three, not the game from the scene
Lava, spikes, and treasure in a thirty-second clip
But the real game is gem swaps on a candy trip
The hand in the ad always picks the wrong pin
Makes me think I could win it, so I tap to begin
Draw a line, save the dog from an angry swarm of bees
Download it, it's a card game, man, I'm begging you, please
It's a trick, it's a trap, it's a tease, it's a test
One star in the reviews and I'm done, unimpressed
sections.name: Verse 1 - Male

lines: Perfect smile on the screen, but she never was real
Never breathed, never blinked, she's a corporate deal
The company saved money and the actors got cut
"Stop hiring humans" on a billboard, what
Fire Steve, hire Ava, that's the pitch that they sell
Steve took a sick day, now he's gone, oh well
Ava booked twelve meetings, never slept, never ate
Never asked for a raise and she never showed up late
Now the law says label it, disclose the machine
But the line's getting blurry in between the scenes
sections.name: Verse 2 - Female

lines: Real or render, true or trick
Click or skip, it makes me sick
Same fake ad, different day
Delete the game, I won't play
